featured_reviews.name: SHUBHAM VYAS
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have purchased almost all of our major electronics and appliances from Croma over the years and never had to use their after-sales service. Unfortunately, when we finally needed support, our experience matched many of the negative reviews we had previously ignored.

We raised a service request for our TV on 11th May. The process was extremely slow, communication was poor, and we had to repeatedly follow up just to get the issue resolved. The TV was eventually replaced on 21st/22nd May.

However, the problems did not end there. As of today, the damaged TV is still lying at our home, occupying space, despite multiple follow-ups and assurances that it would be picked up. We were told calls had been made to us, but we received none. Even after contacting the local store, we were given promises but no action.

It is disappointing that customers have to struggle not only to get a product serviced, but also to get the company's own damaged product collected after replacement.

The sales experience at Croma has always been good, but the after-sales service has been extremely frustrating. Based on our experience, many of the service-related complaints in the reviews appear to be justified.

I hope Croma improves its customer support and service processes going forward.

featured_reviews.name: florina kinny
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst customer service experience ever😡 The staff is polite and convincing only until the product is sold. They are only interested in making sales and selling unnecessary extra warranties. They push customers to purchase extra warranty plans by making false promises about quick and reliable service.
But once you actually need help, nobody takes responsibility. Calls are ignored, staff members speak rudely, and there is absolutely no professionalism. Paying extra for the warranty was a complete waste of money.
I strongly advise customers not to fall for their warranty schemes. Save your money and buy from a store that values customer service and respects its customers.

featured_reviews.name: Chandra Sen
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff was helpful and able to answer my questions. And they are courteous enough to respond on call about availability. Sunil helped me buy a paper shredder and it didn't take time to close the Purchase. The store has 2 floors with ample options to choose from. Good place for electronics and home appliances.

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently purchased a OnePlus 12R from Croma and had a great experience. I was initially confused between the Pixel and OnePlus, but the salesperson patiently explained the features, along with the pros and cons of both phones, which helped me make an informed decision. Thanks to his guidance, I chose the OnePlus 12R and couldn’t be happier. The customer service was truly top-notch, he definitely deserves recognition, even though I unfortunately don’t remember his name. I’m very satisfied with my experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: I would not recommend buying from Croma. Based on my experience, I felt misled as a customer and was disappointed with the service. I expected better transparency and support. I hope the company improves its customer service and handles customer concerns more professionally in the future.

My name is Vimal Mishra. I recently faced an issue while processing a loan through Bajaj Finance at your Croma store.

I purchased a refrigerator from Croma, but it was delivered in a damaged condition. It took around 3 days just to process the replacement. After that, the replacement unit was delivered, but no one came to pick up the damaged fridge.

Overall, a very disappointing experience. Poor customer service and lack of coordination. Not recommended.

featured_reviews.name: bhuvanesh Thevar
featured_reviews.review_text:
am posting this review to formally document my experience.
My device is only 2 months old and has been facing recurring display tint, screen flickering, and a loose/sunken power button despite prior service intervention. Video evidence with IMEI verification has been shared.
During my visits, proper documentation was not consistently provided, and in at least one instance a job sheet was not generated at the time of inspection. For a device under warranty, service documentation is a basic and expected procedure.
Despite repeated visits and visible issues, the device continues to be described as “fit and fine,” which does not align with the observable defects.
The recurrence of problems within such a short purchase period, along with lack of proper service process, has caused significant inconvenience, travel expenses, and mental distress.
I expect resolution in line with standard warranty obligations and consumer protection principles for defective goods.
This review is being posted for transparency and consumer awareness.

featured_reviews.name: kishan mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at this Samsung Service Center. One day prior to my visit, I was informed that the service centre operates from 10 AM to 7 PM. However, when I visited at 11 AM, there was still no technician available.

The staff behavior was also unprofessional and not polite at all. First, I was told that they only had one technician and he was unavailable due to a medical emergency, so I was asked to wait till 12:00 PM. Later, they changed it to 12:30 PM.

When I asked if I could visit the next day instead, the response I received was extremely insensitive: “Can’t say tomorrow, if he dies then what can we do? Please visit another service centre.”

They even shared the technician’s number, but when I called him, he said he would be late and could not confirm when he would arrive. He also mentioned that he mostly stays at another service centre in Malad and had only come here for a visit.

I understand medical emergencies can happen, and I do not want to comment on that situation. However, the same thing could have been communicated politely and professionally. Due to this poor experience, I had to visit another service centre for assistance. Expected much better customer service from Samsung.

featured_reviews.name: Chamunda Xerox
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I am writing to formally escalate a deeply frustrating experience regarding my recent purchase of an AC and a cooler from your store on 08/02/2026
​Both units delivered to my home were defective. While receiving a faulty product is an inconvenience, the subsequent customer service I have received from your team has been completely unacceptable.
​Here is a summary of the ongoing issues:
​Failure to Replace on Time: Despite immediate notification of the defective units, the replacements have severely missed the promised timelines.
​Zero Proactive Communication: There has been an utter lack of intimation from your team regarding the delays. Every update has required multiple follow-ups solely from my end.
​Unresponsive Staff: To make matters worse, your store staff is now blatantly ignoring my calls.
​Pending Delivery: As of writing this email, the replacement cooler has still not been delivered.
​As someone who actively manages customer support operations and handles escalations professionally, I am genuinely appalled by the gross negligence displayed here. Ignoring customer calls, failing to meet basic service SLAs, and leaving a customer in the dark is a terrible reflection on Croma's standards.
​I expect immediate intervention on this matter.
